thread:
maria: Thanks for coming to the all-hands! Quick follow-up thread with the bits folks asked for and who's owning what. I'll keep this short and update as things change.

maria: TL;DR: Dedicated GA targeted for Q3, Private pilot starts May 15, we ship v2.3runtime next week. Links below + action owners. Please ping if I missed something. :sparkles:

jeff: Quick clarification — the p99 latency numbers on slide 18 (70ms) are those per-region or global?

maria: Per-region for Dedicated. Hosted uses smart routing; I'll confirm exact wording and update the FAQ.

anya: Can someone create a repo/folder for the canary rollout playbook? I'll start a draft checklist and runbook. @maria can you assign me?

deploybot: deploybot: Release v2.3 tag created on main. Staging will occur Tue 03:00 UTC. See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/2345

sam: For customer comms — can we get an embargoed one-pager + pricing FAQ? I'll coordinate with finance and growth. Who's the owner for the one-pager?

olivia: Docs will add: migration guide, upgrade path, and an example migration script. Targeting EOW next week for first pass.

maria: Action list I just added to the doc (links below):
- jeff: confirm/lock SLA numbers and add the precise p99 definition by EOD Thu
- anya: draft canary rollout + checklist, initial playbook by next Wed
- sam: embargoed customer one-pager + pricing FAQ draft by next Fri
- olivia: upgrade guide + migration script PR by next Friday
- nina (product): spec for API toggles (quantization + batch control) — draft by May 1
- carlos/eng-ops: grant anya canary infra access and add runbook entries

maria: Links — Recording, slides, and internal release plan:
- Recording: https://zoom.us/rec/share/abc123 (internal)
- Slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ah-slides-2026
- Release plan (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Release+v2.3

jeff: Also from Q&A: will model-level quantization toggles be surfaced in the API or console? Product needs to call this out quickly for partners.

nina: nina (product): plan is both — console controls + API flags for the initial beta. Full docs and examples scheduled in the product spec next week.

anya: @carlos can you add me to the canary test project? I need GCP creds + access to the test queue.

carlos: carlos: added anya to test-project and sent a calendar invite for access walkthrough. :white_check_mark:

maria: If you want to propose edits to the action list, drop them inline in the Confluence page or ping me directly. I'll consolidate owners and update this thread after the EOD check-in. Thanks all! :heart:
